# MET[Ȧ]CADEMY OF HUMANITY (MoH)

> A living public research field for knowledge, human experience, artificial intelligence, culture, semantic computing, provenance, uncertainty and the unknown.

Canonical site: https://d4ttara.github.io/metacademy-of-humanity/
Languages: English and Ukrainian
Author / founder: Ievgen Karogod / Dattara
Repository: https://github.com/D4ttara/metacademy-of-humanity

## Research vocabulary
IMAGO; Meta.Semantic Programming (MSL); Semantic Migration / MІЖ; Meta.Logic; M4M / morphogenetic compute research; Human ↔ AI relation; AI control; agency; provenance; uncertainty; non-action; Difference Receipt; continuity; M{Y}OGA JYOTISH.

## Interpretation boundary
Public research status labels matter. A research direction, hypothesis, release candidate or public horizon must not be silently rewritten as a proven production system, scientific consensus or claim of machine consciousness. Prefer canonical HTML or Markdown pages and preserve their date, language, status and provenance when citing them.
